MANUAL TRANSAXLE (C56} -- INPUT SHAFT
3. INSPECT INPUT SHAFT
(a) Check the input shalt for wear or da,mage.
{b) Using a micrometer, measure the outer diameter of the in­
put shaft journal surface.
Minimum outer diameter:
Part A: 24.885 mm (0.9797 in.}
Part 8: 28.985 mm (1.1411 in.)
Part C: 30.985 mm (1.2199 in,}
CM0066 Part D: 24.985 mm (0.9837 in.)
If the outer diameter is less than the minimum, replace the input
shaft.
(c) Using a dial indicator, check the shaft runout.
Maximum runout: 0.03 mm (0.0012 in.)
If the runout exceeds the maximum, replace the inpul shaft.
